name: Mortal Kombat 3 — Liu Kang Ending
notes: Primary arcade-ending text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Liu Kang's ending directly has him find the strength to defeat Shao Kahn. Later Original-continuity story/biography evidence used by this project confirms only the broader Earth-warriors outcome, so this exact attribution remains ending-strength and is not promoted to canon.
